title: Whistling UFO seen near Aztec
summary: unnamed witness tells of Whistling UFO seen near Aztec, about unspecified at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The UFO came from that [music] direction over there, but it was making this sound like almost whistling.

plain: An unnamed witness near Aztec, New Mexico, where a UFO crash is said to have happened, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a UFO he saw there. He points to the direction it came from and says it made a sound almost like whistling.
